review.tagline: Open Markdown format for giving coding agents project instructions
review.summary: AGENTS.md is a specification for a plain Markdown file kept in a repo that holds dev environment, testing and PR instructions for AI coding agents. The repository also contains the Next.js site served at agents.md, which explains the format and lists examples. It has no runtime or agent code.
review.audience: Maintainers who want to give AI coding agents repo-specific instructions
strengths: Plain Markdown, no tooling, schema or dependencies required
One predictable file location for agent instructions, separate from the human README
Website runs locally with pnpm install and pnpm run dev
weaknesses: No enforced schema; README shows only a minimal example
Repo holds the website and spec, not a tool or agent
README does not list which agents read the file
